contea di ritrovamento: Buckinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [ANT AVG] III VIR R P [C] ; R/ [...] LEG IX

A Roman silver denarius republican coin of Mark Antony, dating to 32-31 BC (Reece period 1), Legionary Denarius for Legio IX. Travelling Mint. RRC p. 540, no. 544/23. Obverse legend reads [ANT AVG] III VIR R P [C]. Obverse shows Galley right, mast with banners at prow. Die axis is 6 or 7 o'clock. Weight is 2.87g, diameter is 18.12mm, thickness is 1.47mm. Reverse legend reads [...] LEG IX. Reverse…
